ios._comment: Rellenar antes de ejecutar `eas submit --profile preview --platform ios`. appleId = email de la cuenta Apple Developer. ascAppId = ID numerico de la app en App Store Connect (lo obtienes tras crear la app en https://appstoreconnect.apple.com). appleTeamId = Team ID de 10 caracteres en https://developer.apple.com/account#MembershipDetailsCard.

Rellenar antes de ejecutar `eas submit --profile production --platform ios`. appleId = email de la cuenta Apple Developer. ascAppId = ID numerico de la app en App Store Connect. appleTeamId = Team ID de 10 caracteres de la membership.
